assertion.text: Erdős Problem #332: declared status 'open'. Formalized: yes. Let $A\subseteq \mathbb{N}$ and $D(A)$ be the set of those numbers which occur infinitely often as $a_1-a_2$ with $a_1,a_2\in A$. What conditions on $A$ are sufficient to ensure $D(A)$ has bounded gaps? Prize: no. Tags: number theory.
